data.description: Per-element rotating-text effect. Cycles through phrases with a typing/erasing animation.

data-aed-typewriter.description: Phrases to cycle. Either a JSON array (e.g. '["design","launch"]') or a separator-delimited string.

data-aed-tw-sep.description: Separator used to split a non-JSON `data-aed-typewriter` value.

data-aed-tw-hold.description: Milliseconds to hold a fully-typed phrase before erasing.

data-aed-tw-loop.description: Loop forever. If false the effect stops on the last phrase.
